short_description: Teladoc BetterHelp Business provides virtual mental health services for health plans and employers through Teladoc's network.
long_description: Teladoc BetterHelp Business is the enterprise and health plan division of Teladoc Health's mental health services, leveraging the BetterHelp platform for B2B clients. The service provides virtual therapy and mental health support to members of health plans, employers, and government programs including Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and TRICARE. Teladoc's acquisition of BetterHelp (2015) combined with its existing telehealth infrastructure allows for broad network coverage and integration with existing health plan benefits. The platform offers licensed therapy via video, phone, and messaging.
